ARCADE RELEASE · TEST FIXTURE

Real app UI checks across every shipped Arcade configuration. Keyboard events are dispatched by this test page; native browser default actions and physical controllers are not covered. Score-entry checks use explicitly seeded synthetic records, not earned game results. Timing is measured from real animation frames, never simulated time. Keep this tab visible while running.
